unresolved.reason: Supplied Vietnamese PDF covers SSW1 only. QC, productivity, management, CL/OL distinction and other SSW2-only terms were compared to Japanese context but cannot all be standardized from this PDF.

contextualFindings.decision: Accept all nha bào changes. Every changed context is bacterial endospores or spore-forming bacteria, not fungal spores. Scientific organism names unchanged.
Accept ngưỡng tới hạn for explicit CL/許容限界 and 1号 CCP limits. Reject six generic 2号 criteria changes as above; no QC control-chart limits are changed.

Accept thời hạn thưởng thức for 賞味期限 and thời hạn tiêu dùng for 消費期限. Internal factory 使用期限 remains hạn sử dụng nguyên liệu/hạn nhà máy. The patch preserves unopened/designated-storage conditions and distinction between safety and best-quality dates.
Săn sóc applies only to the 清潔 5S vocabulary entry; ordinary cleanliness remains unaffected.

Accept nhiệt độ trung tâm, vệ sinh thực phẩm, mối nguy, nhập trước xuất trước, giày bảo hộ, Tay chỉ miệng hô, kiểm tra trước khi vận hành, and complete CCP diagram label as supplied textbook terminology. Most replace valid synonyms to enforce requested textbook consistency.

peerReview.scope: All108 proposed fields independently checked by exact pointers and token diffs; changed meanings compared with Japanese lesson/test context, focused CL/OL generic-criteria cases reviewed in full. All839 question explanation/correct-reason pairs validated after dry application. No repository edits. Older source used only for terminology, never canonical2026 facts or numbers.
limitations: Not a complete native-language or subject-matter certification.
